description: This file declares the RemoteKeyMintOperation class, which implements the BnKeyMintOperation interface for remote key management in Android's security framework. It includes method declarations for cryptographic operation management such as update, finish, and abort, and references external keymaster and secure clock components.

classes.name: RemoteKeyMintOperation
classes.description: Implements the BnKeyMintOperation interface for remote key minting operations, managing cryptographic operation lifecycle and interfacing with the underlying keymaster implementation.

methods.name: RemoteKeyMintOperation
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the operation with a reference to the keymaster implementation and an operation handle.

methods.name: updateAad
methods.description: Updates the Additional Auth Data (AAD) for the ongoing cryptographic operation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Processes input data as part of the cryptographic operation, producing output.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Completes the cryptographic operation, optionally verifying signatures and producing final output.
